papers.title_en: A Framework for Accelerating Transformer Inference on RISC-V for Edge AI
papers.authors: Ajay Kumar M, Vishnu PS, Yike Li, Shreejith Shanker, Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos, Bo Ji, Hans Vandierendonck, Deepu John
papers.evidence: 面向边缘AI的RISC-V Transformer推理加速指令扩展
papers.tldr: 面向资源受限IoT设备上的Transformer语言模型推理，提出基于RISC-V的边缘AI加速框架。针对BERT-Tiny、MobileBERT、MiniLM、Electra、DeBERTa等紧凑模型，提取其非显式计算模式并定制轻量ISA扩展，同时设计加速批量矩阵乘地址生成的自定义指令。结合编译器导向循环展开，在trv32p3f核上实现最高2.19倍推理加速；FPGA与28nm ASIC面积开销分别为32.94%和21.08%。该工作为边缘Transformer部署提供软硬件协同加速路径。
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a framework for accelerating transformer-based language models (LMs) on resource-constrained IoT devices. The framework targets compact LMs: BERT-Tiny (B-Ty), MobileBERT (M-Bt), MiniLM (M-Lm), Electra (E-Lt) and DeBERTa (D-Bt) -- selected for their architectural diversity and use in edge inference scenarios. The proposed flow derives lightweight instruction set extensions tailored to the non-obvious computational patterns of these models. In addition, a custom instruction is introduced to accelerate the address generation stage of batch matrix multiplication, achieving a performance improvement of 15.39--21.74% with modest ASIC overheads of 6.79% in area and 2.33% in power. To further enhance performance without incurring additional processor core hardware cost, an optional compiler-directed loop unrolling strategy is employed, trading increased code size for overall reduced execution time. Evaluation on the Synopsys trv32p3f RISC-V core demonstrates inference speedups of up to 2.19x, and FPGA implementation on the AMD Zynq UltraScale+ ZCU102 shows a 32.94% area overhead at 75 MHz, whereas the ASIC implementation using the TSMC 28 nm library incurs a 21.08% area overhead while operating at 250 MHz.

papers.title_en: TPCS: A Cycle-Level Simulation Paradigm with Native Execution Semantics for RTL Modeling and Generation
papers.authors: Chengzhen Meng, Xiaoyu Li, Chen Bai, Zhenyu Zhang, Hongjun Dai
papers.evidence: 面向微架构设计的周期级仿真与RTL建模
papers.tldr: 面向领域专用架构与微架构早期探索，现有高层仿真快但保真低、RTL仿真准但开销大。TPCS将组合逻辑建模为事务式函数调用，借宿主CPU控制流自然剪除不活跃逻辑，无需显式事件调度或信号追踪。它统一了微架构建模、周期精确仿真与可综合RTL生成，在评估轨迹上保持周期级波形一致。结果显示，SMP上较并行Verilator加速36-42倍，加速器上较单线程Verilator加速3.4-7.2倍，生成RTL的时钟周期与标准单元面积和手工实现相当。它弥合高层建模与RTL设计鸿沟，支持高效pre-RTL工作流。
papers.abstract_en: The growing diversity of domain-specific architectures and microarchitectural designs demands fast and accurate evaluation methods during early design stages. However, existing approaches suffer from a fundamental trade-off: high-level simulators offer speed but lack fidelity, while RTL-based tools provide accuracy at the cost of significant simulation overhead. This gap limits efficient pre-RTL microarchitecture exploration. Therefore, we propose Transaction-Pruned Cycle Simulation (TPCS), a novel modeling and simulation framework. It serves as a unified intermediate abstraction spanning microarchitecture modeling, cycle-accurate simulation, and synthesizable RTL implementation. TPCS organizes combinational logic as transaction-based function invocations and leverages host CPU control flow to naturally prune inactive logic, eliminating the need for explicit event scheduling or signal tracking. This enables cycle-accurate simulation with significantly improved performance. TPCS preserves structural correspondence with RTL and supports automatic generation of synthesizable designs. TPCS achieves 36$\times$-42$\times$ speedups over parallel Verilator on SMP systems and 3.4$\times$-7.2$\times$ over single-threaded Verilator on accelerators, with cycle-level waveform agreement on the evaluated traces. The generated RTL demonstrates comparable timing and area to handcrafted implementations, with relative changes of -4.7\% to +2.6\% in clock period and -3.3\% to +4.0\% in standard-cell area. By bridging the abstraction gap between high-level modeling and RTL design, TPCS enables a unified and agile pre-RTL workflow, allowing efficient microarchitecture exploration with both high performance and implementation fidelity.

papers.title_en: LLM-Augmented Bayesian Optimization with Adaptive Policies for Chiplet Design Space Exploration
papers.authors: Hang Liu, Zhengfei Chen, Zhengrui Chen, Hao Geng, Yu Li, Qi Sun
papers.evidence: CPU-GPU异构芯粒的架构级设计空间探索
papers.tldr: Chiplet是延续摩尔定律的关键路径，但异构系统早期评估平台稀缺，且设计参数与优化指标关系复杂，导致设计空间探索困难。本文提出LLM增强贝叶斯优化框架，面向2.5D/3D CPU-GPU异构芯粒，集成架构级仿真与自动优化；通过扩展开源仿真器支持图拓扑以评估3D设计，并引入LLM生成高质量策略，结合自适应方向策略推理与探索增益感知微调，引导BO高效搜索。在2.5D/3D芯粒实验中，该框架提升了设计空间探索效率。
papers.abstract_en: Chiplet technology is a key approach for extending Moore's Law. However, its design process is constrained by two primary challenges: the scarcity of early-stage platforms for rapidly evaluating chiplet-based heterogeneous systems, and the complex relationships between design parameters and optimization metrics. To address these challenges, we propose a synergistic framework that integrates a Large Language Model (LLM) with Bayesian Optimization (BO), enabling architectural-level simulation and automated optimization for the 2.5D/3D CPU-GPU heterogeneous chiplets. We extend the open-source chiplet simulator to evaluate 3D designs by supporting graph topologies. Further, to enhance the exploration efficiency of BO, we introduce an LLM that generates high-quality policies to guide the optimization process, enabled by our proposed adaptive directional policy reasoning (ADPR) and an exploration gain-aware fine-tuning method. Finally, we use the policy-guided BO to perform an automated and efficient exploration of the complex chiplet design space. Experiments on 2.5D and 3D chiplet reveal that our framework improves design space exploration efficiency.

papers.title_en: LocalTrain: Integer-Only Local Learning for Energy-Efficient CNN Training on Edge FPGAs
papers.authors: Shiqi Ding, Xuanyu Liang, Xinyang Liu, Boyang Li, Zhiqiang Que, Guosheng Hu, Jiayang Li
papers.evidence: 面向CNN训练能效的FPGA加速器
papers.tldr: 边缘端FPGA训练卷积神经网络常受高能耗和跨层依赖制约，局部学习虽能减少反向传播依赖，却仍需保存操作数、累积梯度并选择量化尺度。为此，LocalTrain提出整型局部学习系统，用共享整数矩阵引擎同时训练主干网络与区域辅助分类器，在片内扩展紧凑误差，逐块折叠梯度，并利用历史量化尺度直接完成输出转换。KV260原型在200MHz下于CIFAR-10取得76.57%准确率、SVHN取得91.85%准确率，平均模块功耗约4.20W，有效矩阵吞吐为31.22与31.57 GMAC/s；与Jetson Orin Nano上的同整型方法相比，训练能耗分别降低40.4%和42.1%，但运行时间延长1.86倍和1.82倍。
papers.abstract_en: Local learning reduces cross-layer training dependencies, but an efficient accelerator must still retain operands, accumulate gradients, and select quantization scales. We present an FPGA system that trains a CNN and its regional auxiliary classifiers using a shared integer matrix engine. Compact errors are expanded on chip, gradients are folded tile by tile, and historical scales permit direct output conversion. At 200 MHz, the KV260 prototype achieves 76.57% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and 91.85% on SVHN at approximately 4.20 W mean module power. Effective matrix throughput is 31.22 and 31.57 GMAC/s, respectively. Against the same integer method on Jetson Orin Nano, measured training energy is 40.4% and 42.1% lower, with $1.86\times$ and $1.82\times$ longer runtime; measurements use the respective platform power domains. Selected state checks and matching complete-run prediction counts support functional agreement with the software reference.
